note: INDICATIVE starting values, September 2026. Prices are USD per 1M tokens. 'quality' (1-5) and 'latency_s' are the instructor's starting guesses, not measurements: replace them with your own results from the lab. Null means unknown - look it up on the provider's pricing page and fill it in. Tier rows summarise ranges reported by third-party price trackers in Sep 2026; verify on each vendor's page before relying on them.

models.name: gpt-oss-20b on Groq
models.notes: Our course default. Reasoning model: spends hidden tokens before the visible answer. Free tier for the course.

models.name: gpt-oss-120b on Groq
models.notes: Larger sibling. Same open weights, so it can also be self-hosted (see the self-hosted row).

models.name: Llama 4 Scout 17B-16E on Groq
models.notes: Mixture-of-experts; believed multimodal - we verify image input at Session 13.

models.name: Llama 3.1 8B Instant on Groq
models.notes: Cheapest and fastest here; small. price_out is blank on purpose: look it up and fill it in (exercise 1).

models.name: llama3.2:3b on your laptop (Ollama)
models.notes: Free and fully private, but slow on a laptop and small. Ollama's DEFAULT context window is far smaller than the model's maximum unless you raise num_ctx. One laptop answers one request at a time: it is a development tool, not a service (capacity assumed ~5,000 calls/day).

models.name: gpt-oss-20b self-hosted on a smaller GPU server
models.notes: ASSUMPTION: one smaller GPU server at about 700 USD/month, edit it. Same weights as the hosted row; you carry the operations.

models.name: gpt-oss-120b self-hosted on your own GPU server
models.notes: ASSUMPTION: one dedicated GPU server at about 2,000 USD/month, edit it. No per-token bill, but you run and secure it.
